holes.name: LeanEval.Analysis.ODE.bvp_comparison
holes.body:
/-- **Comparison principle for the Dirichlet BVP.** If two functions are `C²` on an open
interval `J` containing `[0, 1]`, satisfy `-u'' ≤ -v''` on the interior, and are ordered
at the boundary, then `u ≤ v` throughout `[0, 1]`. -/
theorem bvp_comparison
    (J : Set ℝ) (_hJ_open : IsOpen J) (hJ_sub : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ J)
    (u v : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ x ∈ J, HasDerivAt u (deriv u x) x)
    (hu' : ∀ x ∈ J, HasDerivAt (deriv u) (deriv (deriv u) x) x)
    (hv : ∀ x ∈ J, HasDerivAt v (deriv v x) x)
    (hv' : ∀ x ∈ J, HasDerivAt (deriv v) (deriv (deriv v) x) x)
    (hineq : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, -deriv (deriv u) x ≤ -deriv (deriv v) x)
    (hu0 : u 0 ≤ v 0) (hu1 : u 1 ≤ v 1) :
    ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, u x ≤ v x := by
  intro x hx
  have hconv : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (w u v) :=
    w_convexOn J hJ_sub u v hu hu' hv hv' hineq
  have hw0 : w u v 0 ≤ 0 := by
    simpa [w, Pi.sub_apply] using sub_nonpos.mpr hu0
  have hw1 : w u v 1 ≤ 0 := by
    simpa [w, Pi.sub_apply] using sub_nonpos.mpr hu1
  have h_all : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, w u v x ≤ 0 :=
    convexOn_Icc_nonpos_of_endpoints (w u v) hconv hw0 hw1
  have hwx : w u v x ≤ 0 := h_all x hx
  have h_nonpos : u x - v x ≤ 0 := by
    simpa [w, Pi.sub_apply] using hwx
  exact sub_nonpos.mp h_nonpos
